[**Final Year Research Project Placement, Summer’s Lab, Department of Genetics, University of Cambridge \[02/2022 – 04/2022\]**]{.underline}

-   Project on growth relationship between *E. coli* and *Lactobacillus* in human gut microbiome

    -   Investigated growth of *E. coli* in different culture conditions: growth culture supplemented with different products of *E. coli* and *Lactobacillus* tryptophan metabolism. Investigated growth of different strains *E. coli* and *Lactobacillus* when cultured together*.* Bacterial growth tracked in CFU counts over 48 hours.

    -   Investigated if RNase E interact with NUS transcription factors, by carrying out NUS-his tag pull down and western blots.

    -   Hands on experience with general biochemical techniques like gel electrophoresis, western blots, bacterial cultivation, PCR, antibody pull-down assays. Also, learnt specific techniques used in structural biology like HPLC, cryo-EM, qPCR, etc.
